# porch_group (Resource)

A group of tenant members (needs `group:manage`). Members are managed with `porch_group_member`, nesting with `porch_group_parent`. Import with `<tenant>/<group_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_group" "parents" {
  tenant      = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug        = "parents"
  name        = "Parents"
  description = "Grown-ups of the house"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Identifier, unique in the tenant. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID (`grp_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_group.parents <tenant>/<group_id>
```
